source_title: What Are The Fees And Taxes For Selling On Etsy
snippet_primary: "If you're enrolled in Etsy Payments, your fees are automatically deducted from funds from sales. If your balance is negative at the end of the month, you'll have an amount due on the first of the next month."
subject_exact: Etsy policy states Etsy Payments fees are automatically deducted from sales; negative month-end balance results in amount due on the 1st of the following month
